title: QNT September 2026 Price Rise — Causal Audit
question: What most plausibly caused QNT's September 24–26, 2026 price surge, how did the United Kingdom contribute, and what, if anything, was proved about direct QNT value capture?
bluf: The sharp acceleration followed two official September 24 disclosures: The Clearing House selected Quant for the interoperability, orchestration and transaction-management layer of a planned U.S. tokenized-deposit network, while UK Finance reported the first live customer transactions on a Quant-built GBTD platform across seven banks. The U.S. selection is the strongest immediate catalyst; the UK operating receipt materially reinforced it. Neither announcement mentions QNT, token purchases, lockups, burns, staking balances or token-denominated institutional fees, so the move is evidence of market repricing around Quant software adoption, not proof of direct QNT value capture.
